text: Environmental science is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the interaction between human activities and the environment, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as chemistry, biology, geoscience, engineering, and social sciences. Its core objective is to reveal the formation mechanism of environmental problems (such as environmental pollution and ecological damage), and explore sustainable environmental management and protection strategies. Unlike environmental engineering which focuses on pollution control technologies, environmental science leans more towards theoretical research, problem analysis and macro planning, aiming to cultivate compound talents with capabilities in environmental monitoring, ecological assessment, policy formulation and scientific research innovation.
